author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಗ್ನವಾಗುತಲಿಹರು ತಜ್ಞ ತಾವೆನ್ನುವರು
ಭಗ್ನವಾಗಲು ಜನರ ಮೂಢ ನಂಬಿಕೆಯು
ಲಗ್ನವಾಗಲು ಬುದ್ಧಿಶಕ್ತಿಯೊಡೆ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯ
ಮಗ್ನತೆಯ ರೂಢಿಸಿಕೊ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: They call themselves experts and end up exposed,
so that people’s blind beliefs might be broken;
for intellect to be wedded to skill,
en.bhavartha: Self-styled experts are eventually exposed, and that helps break superstition. Real expertise comes when intelligence is joined to skill through deep, absorbed practice.
